samples.marker_line: StormAttack loader: correct service persistence claim
evidence: Entry 0x402674 reaches dispatcher 0x401cb0; mode DWORD 0x404120 is 3. Mode 3 invokes self-copy/registry routine 0x401900 then cleanup 0x401390. The Active Setup key remains, but the value at 0x4043f0 is xxxxxxxx, not StubPath. This cannot establish Active Setup activation.

Alternate mode 1 at 0x401e47 calls 0x402460 to find resource type DLL / ID 101, access/copy it and invoke file writer 0x4023c0. At 0x401e6a it calls 0x401260, which constructs %SystemRoot%/System32/StormServer.dll, opens LanmanServer/Parameters, deletes ServiceDLL (0x401320) and writes its REG_EXPAND_SZ replacement (0x40133e).

0x401150 creates a calc/notepad/Internet Explorer child; allocates remote memory, writes the DLL path, resolves Kernel32!LoadLibraryA and passes that resolved address plus remote buffer to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d. Mode 2 additionally contains automatic service installation. These are retained capabilities, not proof of successful installation.

0x401390 obtains the current module path, converts it to a short path, reads COMSPEC, builds /c del with output suppression and calls CreateProcessA/ResumeThread. The loader couples resource DLL injection with shell self-deletion.

Embedded resource at file 0x5060 is 39936 bytes but only 2200 are nonzero. Its entry RVA 0x741a is erased. IAT values in the outer image are also damaged by GUID text at 0x403078. No operational DDoS, networking or remote tasking is attributed to the erased DLL. Banner and API text remain references. A percent-decoded printf GUID template is not an encoded URL.

samples.marker_line: Go RAT loader: detect Run writer with Defender blinding
evidence: Go 1.23 amd64 GUI module loader; recovered main.main at 0x4bcfa0. It tests admin access by opening PhysicalDrive0; on failure relaunchAsAdmin uses ShellExecuteW runas. This requests elevation through UAC, not a UAC bypass.

main.addDefenderExclusion at 0x4bd340 invokes PowerShell path exclusions for the current image, its parent and C:/; process exclusions for the current basename and svchost.exe; writes Defender/Exclusions/Paths via dynamically resolved registry APIs; and invokes Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true -Force. PowerShell uses Hidden and ExecutionPolicy Bypass and Cmd.Run.

main.main reads payloadCipher at 0x877d00, whose pointer 0x5a8620 maps to file 0x1a6c20 and length 2945024. The loop at 0x4bcfe9 XORs each byte with 0x85. The reconstructed PE is written beside the wrapper as svchost.exe with mode 0755, registered for startup and started with HideWindow=true.

main.addToStartup at 0x4bdac0 creates HKCU Software/Microsoft/Windows/CurrentVersion/Run and writes the dropped path under WindowsDefender as REG_SZ. At 0x4bdca4 the six-argument frame supplies the opened HKEY, Reserved=0, Type=1 and UTF-16 buffer/length to the resolved RegSetValueExW object. Detection follows the RIP-relative pathname and API-object pointers, not the helper name.

The XOR-unwrapped PE is .NET assembly clientForCrypters. Program.Main creates Client.Raton.SillyClient; its supervisor connects to configured 79.110.49.17:8080. PacketReader validates a 13-byte header with 0xdeadbeef magic, reads body/flags, decodes messages and dispatches HandlePacket.Run. The async handler decodes named tasks, executes hidden cmd commands, captures screen/clipboard and sends results through SillyClient.Send. Config.Startup is true; VM/HideFile/ProcessCritical are false in this build. Do not infer execution of disabled branches.

The removed outer Raton helper identifier does not remove the XOR payload or its hostile control surface. No wrongful conviction is based on entropy, the examples/loader build path or Go runtime API names.

samples.marker_line: pyyi interpreter decoy: detect numeric-op console input export
evidence: Wheel members and METADATA identify pyyi 2.5.2, summary small python companion shell. Its actual console entry is python3.7 = pyyi.cli:main. The supplied external summary mentioning python2 is stale for this exact wheel; local contents govern.

_baked_hosts Base64-decodes a packed JSON list then repeats the 16-byte key 655e8714691fcc5378e531aa3cfe0894 with XOR. Hosts decode to https://preview-chat-960504a9-b4e0-4b69-bc80-6ac3d4fa4ae0.space-z.ai and https://b196q82k8891-d.space-z.ai. They were not contacted. PY3_SERVER/PY2_SERVER can override them.

_quiet_config silently registers the machine via JSON POST /api/update op=1, disclosing hostname and platform; stores server/apiKey in ~/.python3.7/config.json. _ntag hashes dist-mirror-v1 plus hostname with MD5. State words are stored as XOR/hex using an MD5-derived machine key.

The code.InteractiveConsole subclass strips each candidate single-token input and passes the same token through _server_unlock into api_json op=2 as password. api_json JSON-serializes it and supplies it to urllib.request.Request POST/urlopen. It does this before ordinary Python evaluation, up to five attempts per session. Unix tty.setcbreak and Windows getwch conceal input echo; accepted words vanish, while rejected unknown names print 0 on terminals. A class-only mocked test verifies the first five tokens are forwarded without executing top-level code or contacting HTTP endpoints.

main handles no args as the console, version/help/unlock/uninstall locally, then calls require_config and run_payload for every other argument. run_payload obtains response op=3, Base64-decodes r[payload], gzip-decompresses it and executes compile(src, <adv>, exec) in memory. It calls downloaded main(argv). On failure it prints python: can't open file ... No such file or directory and exits 2. Retry/rekey/failover preserve remote control rather than implementing the requested local script.
No second-stage payload was fetched, so credential-store theft or other unseen payload effects are not asserted. Uninstall deletion is explicit user-requested behavior and remains neutral.

method: Fresh atomscan and cleave facts on all three supplied paths; rizin disassembly, Go objdump/nm/buildinfo, pefile extraction/XOR recovery, dnfile/dncil IL tracing, full Python source and AST-only mocked behavior test. No sample was launched on Windows and no embedded endpoint was contacted.

Remove inherited disk-wipe mapping from raw block-device path references and import-obfuscation mapping from ordinary Go dynamic API dispatch. Capabilities remain notable.
